ios.desc:
Embark on an epic journey through the minimalist galaxy!

Welcome to "Galactic Admirals," a minimalist casual fun 2D naval real-time strategy game set in space that brings the thrill of space battles right to your fingertips. Perfect for those seeking a fun, quick, and casual gaming experience, Galactic Admirals challenges you to master the art of navigation and combat in the vast expanse of space.

Intuitive Controls:
- Navigate your ship effortlessly with our tap and hold mechanism. Drag a path for your vessel and watch it follow your command with precision. Your strategic prowess and quick reflexes will determine your survival!

Engaging Gameplay:
- Stay on the move to avoid enemy ships and obstacles like asteroids. Keep your adversaries within the range of your turrets and unleash devastating attacks. Every moment counts in the field of battle!

Minimalist Design:
- Enjoy a clean, visually appealing interface that keeps you focused on the action. The minimalist design ensures an immersive experience without unnecessary distractions.

Power Weapons:
- Ion Torpedos, Ion Cluster Bomb, and Mobile Autonomous Drones - fun and powerful power ups that help you overcome the odds against enemy frigates that can match your ship toe to toe. Even the playing field with this powerful new weapon.

Infinite Playable Space:
- Explore the endless expanse of space. Navigate through a limitless environment that offers boundless opportunities for strategy and exploration.

Two Ways to Play:
- Start Game: Brace yourself for waves of enemy ships. Your mission is to command your ship through relentless onslaughts and emerge victorious.
- Training Academy: Hone your skills and see how many enemy ships you can outmaneuver and destroy. Perfect for beginners and seasoned players alike.

Free to Play:
- Dive into the action without spending a dime. Galactic Admirals is free to download, ensuring everyone can join the interstellar fun.

Continuous Updates:
- We're committed to keeping the game fresh and exciting. Expect new levels and content in future updates, ensuring there's always something new to explore and conquer.

Why You'll Love Galactic Admirals
- Quick and Casual: Ideal for short gaming sessions, perfect for a quick escape from your daily routine.
- Strategic Depth: Simple controls but endless possibilities. Plan your moves carefully to outsmart your enemies.
- Visually Appealing: Enjoy the minimalist yet captivating graphics that bring battles to life.
- Community-Driv

show_hn.title: Show HN: I am slowly building a mobile epic RTS game with 10k ships

quotes.text:
Here we go, another indie game dev story haha.

I've been a gamer for as long as I can remember, always dreaming of making my own games one day. Life got in the way for a long time, but now I've finally had the chance to create Galactic Admirals (https://www.galacticadmirals.com), my love letter to the RTS genre, the promise of mobile gaming with a retro minimalist touch. I goal is to put 10,000 playable ships on the screen.

Inspired by my love of games, movies, anime, and novels about naval warfare, space, and strategy, this game is something I've dreamt about for a long time. The current version of the game available is just the first step. Rather than building something massive, complicated, and something no one wants to play, I am focused on building in steps.

Focus for now is getting the core gameplay right; so I am building fast and slowly lol, keeping it small on purpose, shipping it quickly so I can expand it piece by piece, learning and improving along the way. With each update, I aim to refine and expand the game, learning from your feedback every step of the way.

I hope you'll give Galactic Admirals a try and share your honest feedback.

P.S. I am going to blog along the way. I think the cool kids call it buildingitinpublic =). https://galacticadmirals.com/#developer-blog
